neighbours.label: the slot right before 'reputation' (or fame/notoriety) is predicted: the article or adjective after 'gained/earned/built' when 'reputation' comes next
fire: Over the years the small bakery has earned a solid reputation for its sourdough.
Within a few seasons the young striker had built a fearsome reputation among defenders.
The law firm quickly gained a strong reputation for winning difficult cases.
After the scandal, the senator struggled to repair his damaged reputation with voters.
The hotel enjoys an excellent reputation locally for the quality of its service.
That garage has a bad reputation for overcharging customers on simple repairs.
She soon acquired a reputation as the toughest examiner in the department.
The invasive weed has gained notoriety across the region for choking native plants.
quiet: Over the years the small bakery has earned a loyal following for its sourdough.
Within a few seasons the young striker had built a powerful frame through training.
The law firm quickly gained a large client base after opening downtown.
After the scandal, the senator struggled to repair his old car before winter.
The hotel enjoys an excellent location near the station and the old harbour.
That garage has a big parking lot behind the workshop for waiting customers.
She soon acquired a taste for strong coffee during the night shifts.
The invasive weed has gained ground across the region since the wet spring.

notes: card: peaks on the token just before 'reputation'; output direction of + pole suppresses reputation/fame, so - pole promotes it
